name: Klaipeda University
summary: Coastal university in Klaipeda with 15 English-taught bachelor's in engineering, marine technology, business, social sciences and humanities.

ib.text: Upload your IB diploma and results (average above 60%); English needs IELTS 5.5 or equivalent unless you are a native speaker. An online interview follows a positive review.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering (Environment and Energy)
programmes.about: Analysing and developing chemical and technological processes to create new products, with an interdisciplinary approach to research and sustainable industry.
programmes.overview: The core subjects are process engineering, process and equipment simulation, design of technological processes, environmental technology and renewable energy sources, taught with an interdisciplinary view of emerging research areas. The aim is to analyse and develop chemical and technological processes and to work in a fast-changing chemical industry. Graduates can also apply this knowledge in environmental protection departments and nature conservation bodies, and the university offers related master's programmes in innovative processes engineering and production engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Design, programming, maintenance and operation of industrial automation equipment, with electrical circuits and technologies for current and future systems.
programmes.overview: You study electrical circuits, electrical machines and drives, information technologies, industrial controls and communication, electricity and renewable energy, and microcontrollers. Courses include robotic systems, renewable energetics and energy efficiency, microprocessors, programmable logic controllers and electrical transport systems, with a focus on designing, programming, maintaining and operating industrial automation equipment. Graduates can work in electronics, electric power, transport, automation and robotics, renewable energy and electrical system design, and a related master's programme in innovative electrical and automation systems is available.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Designing mechanical devices, materials and how they are made, with computer design tools and teamwork to build working machines and robots.
programmes.overview: The curriculum includes an introduction to mechanical engineering, computer-aided structural design, automatic control of mechatronic systems, computerised design of processing technologies and environmental engineering. You learn to work in teams and with other specialists to create working devices, robots and machines, using modern computer design programmes. Graduates become design engineers, consultants, experts or department heads in industries such as furniture, textiles, chemicals and recycling, and some move into laboratory research. Related master's programmes are production engineering and innovative processes engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Marine Transport Engineering
programmes.about: Marine transport engineering combined with IT, plus modules in naval architecture and shipbuilding for ship design and operation.
programmes.overview: Marine engineering is combined with IT infrastructure, with courses in the basics of ship design, ship hydro-aeromechanics, marine environmental protection technologies, shipbuilding and repair technology, and business and engineering project management. The specialisation is Naval Architecture and Shipbuilding, which develops skills in ship design and digital innovation and addresses the environmental standards of the International Maritime Organization. Graduates work as constructors, ship architects, engineers or project managers in shipbuilding design, construction and repair, and can continue to the master's programme in shipping and port engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Port Technology Management
programmes.about: Managing port technologies and computerised systems, solving logistics problems and working on smart autonomous ports and e-logistics.
programmes.overview: You learn to manage port technologies, use computerised IT systems and solve logistics problems, with attention to smart autonomous ports and e-logistics. Graduates work as engineers in maritime and transport sectors, port administration, stevedoring, ship agency and freight forwarding, in roles such as technical consultant, industrial manager or project manager, or as entrepreneurs. The degree leads on to master's study, with shipping and port engineering offered as a related option at the same university.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Informatics
programmes.about: Computational science, software systems and data analysis: developing software with current technologies, including web design.
programmes.overview: The subjects include artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, web technologies and digital graphics, computer networks and the internet of things, object-oriented programming, computer architecture and operating systems, data mining and simulation modelling. Graduates can work as software developers, data analysts, cybersecurity analysts, AI and machine learning engineers, web developers, UX designers or researchers, in sectors such as healthcare, finance, e-commerce and government.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Physical Geography and Oceanography
programmes.about: Research and practice on the physical environment with a marine focus, using geo-information technologies for marine environment and land management.
programmes.overview: The subjects are oceanography, remote sensing methods, GIS, hydrology, and meteorology and climatology, applied to marine and environmental questions. Practice includes field work on the university's marine research vessel and technologies from drones to satellite image analysis for monitoring the environment. Graduates interpret natural, climatic and social phenomena in practice and work in nature protection and other environmental institutions or in hydrometeorological services.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.about: Theory, research and data analysis applied to business, finance and government: economic policy, micro and macroeconomics, regional and European economics, taxation.
programmes.overview: Courses include micro- and macroeconomics, economic policy, regional and European economics, enterprise economics, the service economy, economic analysis and modelling, environmental economics, finance and investment, marketing, project management, corporate social responsibility and taxation. You apply theory, research and data analysis skills to real-world issues. Graduates work as economists in the public, private and non-profit sectors, and the university offers related master's degrees in business management and regional governance.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Management
programmes.about: Prepares management specialists who can work responsibly in changing organisations and start or develop a business.
programmes.overview: The curriculum covers crisis management, business analytics, e-business, business ethics and social responsibility, and entrepreneurship, combining theory with practice and taught by academics and practitioners of management. Graduates can start their own business or work as functional managers in personnel, finance, production or marketing. A related master's programme in business management is available for further study.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.
programmes.ib: Autumn entry starts 1 September; a second, spring entry exists for this programme.

programmes.name: Recreation and Tourism
programmes.about: Functions and challenges of recreation and tourism services, service quality and planning, with a specialisation in health tourism.
programmes.overview: Main courses include leadership and change management, resort, spa and wellness studies, tourism structure and resources, and recreation and tourism management and planning. You choose between two specialisations, Health Tourism and E-Tourism. Graduates work as managers in travel agencies, accommodation and recreation businesses, tourism information centres, national and regional park administrations and municipalities, or set up their own businesses; about a tenth work abroad. Related master's programmes include business management and health care management.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Social Work and Crisis Intervention
programmes.about: Applying crisis-intervention methods and helping socially disadvantaged people and groups, in a programme that also starts in February.
programmes.overview: The programme focuses on crisis intervention methods and social work practice: managing difficult situations and giving timely help to socially disadvantaged people and groups, with emphasis on the personal strength and leadership of a future social worker. Graduates work in municipal social support departments, addiction centres, homes for the elderly or children, social service centres, NGOs, health care institutions and hospitals, and can continue in social work, health care management, public administration, social pedagogy or management.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: English Philology
programmes.about: English linguistics and applied philology, preparing linguists who can use communication skills creatively in two foreign languages.
programmes.overview: The subjects include English language and lexicology, introduction to linguistics, the history and culture of Great Britain, intercultural communication, English stylistics, trends in modern linguistics, literary and linguistics seminars, and translation theory and practice, with a second foreign language chosen from Swedish, Spanish or German. Graduates work in municipal government, chambers of commerce, insurance, tourism, media translation departments and marine organisations, and can continue to a master's in linguistics.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: History of Europe
programmes.about: Three-year exploration of the political, social and cultural history of Europe's regions, from the Mediterranean to the Baltic and from West to East.
programmes.overview: You study the histories of European regions from the Mediterranean to the Baltic and from west to east, together with applied subjects such as heritage communication, geopolitics, climate change and digital humanities, and themes including conflict resolution, human rights, migration, nationalism and epidemics. Teaching is in small groups, mixing on-campus and online courses, and builds research, dissemination and communication skills. Graduates go into education, research, museums, archives and libraries, heritage conservation, journalism, public affairs and teaching.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Public Health
programmes.about: Population health: analysing the health status of groups, major health problems, prevention, outbreak control and leadership in public health.
programmes.overview: The programme covers assessing population health, preventing disease and injury, developing health promotion programmes, epidemiology including outbreak control, vaccination programmes and organising preventive care. Graduates work in municipal health departments, public health offices and centres, health promotion units, primary health care institutions and specialised care facilities, and as public health specialists in educational institutions. A related master's programme in public health education is available.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

programmes.name: Leisure Sports
programmes.about: Sport and leisure activities with a physical education teacher qualification.
programmes.overview: You choose one of four tracks: basketball, football, sports dances or leisure sports. Coursework covers sports pedagogy and training methods, from movement control and training basketball players to coaching and elite youth football development, standard and Latin American dance, and agility games, gymnastics and adult fitness. Courses are partly hybrid, and partners include the Lithuanian Basketball Federation, FC Barcelona methodology and the Lithuanian Football Federation, which offers UEFA coaching licences during studies. Graduates earn a physical education teaching qualification and work as coaches, fitness specialists, teachers and personal trainers.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your school certificate (average above 60%) and English proof; a positive result leads to a conditional letter and an online interview.

notes: EU citizens pay the same tuition as others, €3,250 or €4,201 a year, but a lower application fee of €75 instead of €180; tuition is refunded in full if a visa is refused.
The English pages of KU mention the national LAMA BPO route only for Lithuanian-school graduates; the English programmes on the fall-intake list are applied for on apply.ku.lt.
Management and Social Work and Crisis Intervention also have a February intake, with a 1 November deadline.
